chain_words.nuance: financially secure, with enough money for daily needs
finding it hard to pay for everything needed
general lack of money or resources
having no money, possessions or basic means at all

explanation: These words all describe lacking money or resources, from being financially secure at one end to having nothing at all at the other.

usage_notes.difference: 'Poor' describes a general lack of money; 'destitute' describes a state of complete lack of basic necessities.
